name: video-bakeoff-tools
description: Local ffmpeg/ffprobe binaries for normalization and probing (no system install).

scripts.normalize: for e in hyperframes remotion; do ./normalize.sh ../out/$e-raw.mp4 ../out/$e-reels.mp4 && (. ./env.sh && python3 verify_reels.py ../out/$e-reels.mp4 --json ../out/$e-reels.verify.json); done
